<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that converts an alkene into a vicinal diol (breaks an alkene, forms a diol). This will be used for the asymmetric dihydroxylation step.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=CC1CC(C)CC1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["alkene"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["diol"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
